findings.title: update command interactive stdin blocks agent execution
findings.suggested_fix: Remove interactive stdin branch. When --content is absent, fail with clear error: 'mem0 update <task_id> --content <text>'. Agents must use --content explicitly.

findings.title: status command uses Rich console rendering, output not machine-parseable
findings.suggested_fix: Add --format json flag to status. StatusPlane model has .render() method that produces machine-parseable text output but CLI only exposes Rich visualization.

findings.title: update_cognitive_triad is CLI-accessible but not exposed via CLI
findings.suggested_fix: Add CLI command 'mem0 define <task_id> --picture <text> --requirements <items> --constraints <items>' to expose update_cognitive_triad.

residual_risks: update_todo is not CLI-exposed — agents cannot update todos via CLI. Only update_cognitive_triad and create have CLI commands.
testing_gaps: No tests for update --content with empty string
No tests for close_task with failing verification tiers
